correctness.rationale: For every nonnegative degree, the SU(2) Sym^ell character equals U_ell(<x,y>) and restricts to the 120-vertex binary icosahedral group. Regular character orthogonality gives eigenvalue 120m_i/d_i with dimension d_i². The labelled affine E8 McKay graph and Clebsch–Gordan prove the integer recurrence and dimension sum. The group has exponent 60, proving the exact kernel identity K_{ell+60}=K_ell+60(I+(-1)^ell J) from character values at the two central elements. Vanishing of the characters at group elements of orders 4, 6 and 10 shows perfect tightness if and only if ell is 29 modulo 30. An invariant degree-12 binary form gives an injection of all Sym^ell modules into Sym^{ell+12}; the six exact vectors for odd degrees 29..39 and even degrees 60..70 prove all later parity rank-60 statements. Earlier degree 27 rank 56 and degree 58 rank 59 make the thresholds optimal. The standalone `CHECK.py` checker passed 241 assertion groups including 120x120 numerical spectra for ell=0..14; numerical experiments are corroborative only.
